rules.description: Focus on React/TypeScript code in frontend/src/ directory
rules.instruction: Work primarily in frontend/src directory. Follow existing component patterns.

rules.description: Use Vite for build and dev server
rules.instruction: Configure Vite in vite.config.ts. Use Vite plugins for additional functionality.

rules.description: Follow Tailwind CSS conventions for styling
rules.instruction: Use utility classes. Avoid custom CSS when possible. Use Tailwind config for theme customization.
Place components in src/components. Follow the existing naming and organization patterns.

rules.description: Write tests with Vitest and React Testing Library
rules.instruction: Write tests for components and hooks. Use RTL for user-centric tests. Place tests alongside components.

rules.description: Maintain the existing API client pattern in src/api/
rules.instruction: Use the established API client structure. Handle errors consistently. Use TypeScript types for API responses.
No any types. Define proper interfaces. Use type inference when possible. Avoid type assertions.

rules.description: Follow the existing page routing structure
rules.instruction: Place pages in src/pages. Use the established routing configuration.
